page.description: Maintaining an exclusive mandate requires total transparency. Discover how to deploy premium, branded Seller Activity Reports to keep your vendors informed of their listing’s exact market performance, track vital engagement metrics, and justify your strategic decisions.
page.body:
Vendor Reporting: Deploying Seller Activity Reports


Securing a high - value mandate is only the first step; retaining the vendor's trust throughout the sales process is paramount. Sellers expect regular, data - backed updates on how their asset is performing in the active market. If you need to recommend a strategic price reduction, you must have concrete data to justify the adjustment.
The PropertyList infrastructure allows you to generate comprehensive Seller Activity Reports. These premium reports operate as a highly powerful upsell opportunity and client retention tool, providing your vendors with absolute transparency regarding their property's digital performance and tracking exact listing exposure.

Core Strategic Metrics: What is Included?

The Seller Activity Report compiles advanced analytics into a single, highly visual presentation. Your vendors will receive a detailed breakdown of the following vital metrics:

  • Listing Views: Track the total volume of impressions the property has received across the Smart MLS and public portals, demonstrating the exact reach of your marketing efforts.
  • Click-Through Rate (CTR): Monitor the percentage of buyers and co - broking agents who actively click to view the full property details after seeing it in the initial search grid.
  • Saved as Favourite Count: Reveal exactly how many users have actively bookmarked the mandate, indicating strong underlying market interest even if an offer has not yet been submitted.
  • Enquiries Received: Provide a transparent ledger of all direct leads, viewing requests, and MLS co - broking enquiries generated by the listing.
  • Comparable New Listings: Keep the vendor educated on their direct competition by highlighting newly listed, comparable properties that have recently entered the same hyper - local market.
  • Market Shifts: Equip your sellers with real - time intelligence regarding regional price fluctuations, inventory absorption, and shifting market dynamics that directly affect their asset's positioning.

The Premium Upsell: Branded & Per - Listing

We understand that professional presentation is critical to an agency's brand authority. The Seller Activity Report is a premium feature deployed on a per - listing basis using your flexible pay-as-you-go account credits.


When deployed, the infrastructure generates a stunning, fully branded PDF document featuring your agency's logo and contact details.
This allows you to effortlessly send high - level, professional progress reports directly to your sellers, cementing your status as a data - driven market expert and ensuring you retain the exclusive mandate until the deal is successfully closed.
